title: Function workflow
description: One recurring piece of a function's work, at packages/naive/src/functions/<id>/workflows/<workflow id>.json: what the run is for (goal) and which telos measure kinds it moves (measures), what starts it, the steps the function's agent takes, the records each step writes through the router, the decision classes a step may raise, the activity a step performs, whether a step is required or one to consider, and the done criteria in the handoff's form (handoff.schema.json done_criteria), so a workflow run can be handed off and verified like any other work. Every route a step writes must be in the function's write reach, and every class it raises must have a row in the function's decisions.json and every activity a step names must be an APQC activity or a catalog activity under the function's APQC category, every measure must be one of the function's in function.json, and every workflow has a goal, a done criterion and at least one required step (packages/naive/src/checks/check-functions.ts).

requires.description: What must exist before this runs (EE-217, packages/naive/src/engine/prerequisites.ts). It fails closed: an entry that cannot be resolved blocks, `naive due` and `naive loop` never start a blocked workflow, `naive agent run --workflow` refuses one, and the router refuses a write to a route only blocked workflows write, for an agent and for a person alike. A step inherits its workflow's entries and may add its own. A venture loosens or tightens an entry under `prerequisites` in naive.config.json, which names the person who set it.

records.description: Record routes whose record must be live in the venture, such as foundation/problem. A draft the gate holds is not live until a person accepts it.

meetings.description: Function workflows, `<function>/<workflow>`, that a meeting must have walked and closed with its goal reached (meeting.schema.json, EE-200). This is how a person's meeting, and the records drafted in it, come before the work.

decisions.description: Decisions a person must have decided. A shipped workflow names none, because a venture's decision ids are its own; only its naive.config.json does.

goal.description: What one run is for, in one plain sentence: the state the venture's records are in when the run is done. The title names the work; the goal names the outcome, so an agent can tell a finished run from a performed one.

measures.description: The telos measure kinds this workflow moves (foundation/telos measures[].kind), each one of its function's measures in function.json. This is how an agent says which of the venture's goals its work serves: a goal binds a measure, and a lead weighs the workflow by it.

kind.description: intake: once, when the function joins a venture, and again when its records are missing. schedule: on a cadence. event: when a route is written. request: when a lead or person hands it off.

cadence.description: For schedule, and only for schedule: without it a schedule is never due.

route.description: For event, and only for event: the route pattern whose write starts it. Without it an event trigger is never due.

during.description: Only while a time box of this kind is open that lists the workflow or its function (operations/time-boxes/<id>.json, EE-186). Outside one the workflow is not due, whatever its kind says.

reads.description: Route patterns the agent reads first.

do.description: What the agent does, in one plain sentence.

skill.description: A skill in the function's skills/ folder to load for this step.

ask.description: True when the step asks the person, because only they know the answer.

raises.description: Decision classes this step may raise.

consider.description: Present when the step is one to consider, not one the workflow requires (EE-181). The agent runs it only when `when` holds, or when a person asks, and otherwise reports that it considered the step and why it did not run it. A step without `consider` is required: the agent runs it or raises a decision.

why.description: Why a person might want this step, in one plain sentence.

when.description: The condition under which the agent runs the step without being asked, in one plain sentence. Without it, only a person's ask runs the step.

activity.description: The activity this step performs: the hierarchy id of an APQC level 4 activity in packages/naive/src/functions/pcf.json, such as 3.5.1.6, or the id of an activity in packages/naive/src/functions/activities.json. It must sit under the function's APQC category.
